description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Pipedrive persons via search-then-write. Pipedrive has no native upsert endpoint, so this searches /persons/search by key_field, then updates the match or creates a new person.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Pipedrive person (upserted via key_field).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_upserted / rows_errored). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Pipedrive.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

key_field.label: Key Field
key_field.description: Pipedrive field key to search on (e.g. 'email', or a custom field hash key). MUST be present in fields_map values.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column holding the value to match key_field on.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Pipedrive person field key.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Safety cap on total rows per run.

name: Pipedrive Person Upsert
